fields.description: Set on change; cleared once a sync run has pushed this group's grant to every Active proxy.
fields.label: Pending Sync

fields.description: What this group is for, e.g. "internal staff" or "acme early access".
fields.label: Description

fields.description: How far ahead of everyone else this group's requests are served when an engine is saturated. Higher = more important; 0 is the baseline every ungrouped user gets. The gateway stamps it on each request as vLLM's `priority` (flipping the sign, since vLLM serves the lowest number first). Only bites on models whose Scheduling Policy is `priority`. Note there is no aging: under sustained load from a higher group, a lower one can wait a long time and have running requests preempted.
fields.label: Priority

fields.description: Models the members may call. This is the main way access is granted — add the model here and everyone in the group can reach it. Membership is set on each Grove User, not here.
fields.label: Model Access
